none: PAS WAW-023BE1: ROman coin: Denarius of the Civil war period
contea di ritrovamento: Warwickshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Rally ID: 42. Roman coin: A struck / hammered silver denarius, of the Civil War period AD 68-69, of Spanish issue. Obverse: Libertas bust facing right, draped, wearing necklace and with hair looped behind head. Obverse inscription: LIBERTAS [RESTITVTA]. Reverse: Oak wreath with SPQR in centre of round shield. Reverse inscription: SPQR. Reference: RIC vol 1, p205, #27. Diameter: 17.21mm.…
